messages:
sophia: Heads-up — I'm opening the first batch of PRs to rename guides/getting-started -> guides/quickstart and to move the landing TOC. These will touch ~40 files and a couple of redirects files.

mike: thanks — are you planning to do a single monorepo PR or multiple smaller ones?

sophia: multiple. plan is: (1) small rename PRs by section (quickstart, auth, deployments) so docs-preview can build per-PR, (2) a follow-up that adds temporary frontmatter redirects for any pages that change slugs, (3) final cleanup that removes old redirects after 2 weeks.

elaine: important — linkchecker (docs-preview/linkcheck) will fail if redirects aren't present on first merge. We should add redirects in the same PR that moves the files or in a tiny follow-up that merges before other changes.

mike: I'd prefer: move + redirect in same PR to avoid broken anchors in downstream references. But that will make PRs larger.

sophia: agreed. tradeoff noted. for the large sections (auth + deployments) I'll split into 2 PRs: move+redirect combined. smaller pages can be grouped.

tim: tagging reviewers: @mike and @elaine for the migration PRs; we should get at least 1 docs + 1 eng review (label: docs/rename). Also let's use draft PRs while link checks are green before marking for merge.

mike: can we add a quick script to assert no internal anchors break? I can add a tiny script to run after the move that scans for broken in-page anchors and failing external links. Example: `npx broken-link-checker --filter internal` or our existing `scripts/check-doc-links.js`.

elaine: yes please add script and wire it to the docs-preview job. docs-ci-bot: pls run preview for each PR and post the preview URL.

docs-ci-bot: (automated) docs-preview build queued: PR #3214 — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3214

sophia: FYI some pages have anchors like `#installing-on-gpu` referenced from release notes. We need to either keep the same anchor or add heading alias frontmatter so anchor doesn't change. Otherwise all those release notes links will 404.

mike: Good catch. For headings, prefer stable anchor if possible. If the heading text must change, add `id: installing-on-gpu` in frontmatter.

elaine: Sequence proposal: 
- PR A: quickstart section (move + redirects + anchor ids) — small, 1 reviewer 
- PR B: auth section (move + redirects + anchor ids) — bigger, 2 reviewers, schedule merge window 
- PR C: deployments (same) 
- PR D: global TOC update + remove reference to old paths (final)
- PR E: cleanup (remove temporary redirects after 2 weeks)

sophia: That works. We should also coordinate merge times to avoid docs-preview spike causing CI throttling. I suggest merges spaced 20–30 minutes apart during low traffic (US morning).

tim: I'll reserve merge slots on the calendar: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00 PT tomorrow. Please don't merge outside slots unless urgent.

mike: Will add GH reviewers and the `docs/rename` label. Also adding a `hold-for-preview` label so merges wait until the preview job is green.

elaine: For redirects, use the frontmatter `redirect_from` pattern we already have. Example snippet to include at top of moved file: 
```yaml
---
redirect_from:
  - /guides/getting-started/quickstart
---
```
This keeps the Netlify/Docusaurus redirect plugin happy.

sophia: Also a special note about cross-repo links: the integrations repo references some guides using absolute paths. I'll open a follow-up PR in integrations to point to the new slugs after we merge PRs A–C.

mike: QA: after each merge, run `scripts/check-doc-links.js` on main + the preview build. If any failure, revert the merge and patch quickly.

sophia: One more: some customers have pinned links in KB articles; let's post a brief message in #customer-success after the big sections merge so they can update if needed.

elaine: Agreed. I'll draft a short blurb for CS to send to top customers and KB owners.

tim: TL;DR action items: 
- sophia: open PR A–C with move+redirects, add anchor ids when heading changes (due today EOD).
- mike: add link-check script and GH labels + reviewers.
- elaine: wire link check to docs-preview and prepare CS blurb.
- tim: reserve merge windows and coordinate final cleanup timing.

sophia: thanks team. I'll post PR links here as they open. First one coming in 30m :eyes:

mike: :thumbsup:

sophia: PR A opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3214 — includes quickstart move + redirects + anchor fixes. docs-ci-bot: preview posted.

docs-ci-bot: (automated) docs-preview build successful: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3214 — linkcheck: OK

mike: Reviewing now. if all good i'll approve and queue for 09:00 PT slot.

elaine: Approved from docs side. left a minor comment on wording.

mike: Approved. queueing for merge at 09:00 PT.

sophia: merging in slot. thanks all :partyparrot:

docs-ci-bot: (automated) merged PR #3214 into main by sophia

mike: great. next PR B incoming in ~45m.

sophia: noted — will open draft PR for auth shortly and ping reviewers.
